data.summary: **AIRCRAFT** units have just one move type available: the **[Ingress move](vsdata:core-rule/ingress-move)**. As the opposing player’s turn ends, send any of your **AIRCRAFT** units still on the table back to **[Strategic Reserves](vsdata:core-rule/strategic-reserves)**. Moving models can pass through **AIRCRAFT** models. Without **[FLY](vsdata:core-rule/flying-models)** for its **[Surge](vsdata:core-rule/surge-move)**, **[Consolidation](vsdata:core-rule/consolidation-move)** or **[Pile-In](vsdata:core-rule/pile-in-move)** move, a unit ignores **AIRCRAFT** when choosing enemy units and checking which enemy is closest. Being **[Engaged](vsdata:core-rule/engagement-range)** only with **AIRCRAFT** leaves a unit eligible for a **[Normal move](vsdata:core-rule/normal-move)** or an **[Advance move](vsdata:core-rule/advance-move)**, subject to the other requirements of those moves.
